titulo: Starlink access for Ukraine limited after Trump’s claims satellite service restored, officials say – Europe live
cuerpo: The satellite service was still operating at a cap of 161km/hr, crippling key air defences But Macron’s government has ramped up restrictions and protest curbs, to try and stop the looting and ransacking we saw on the fringes of the wider peaceful demonstrations last week. Critics this morning are lambasting the “repressive” measures. What protests are planned? Both student groups and trade unions have planned rallies across the country. France’s ⁠main student union, UNEF, has called for demonstrations on Saturday and the Yellow Vest movement also filed plans to march through central Paris. There are already overnight curfews in place in Paris and many other cities. In Marseille and Lyon, the second and third-largest cities, all demonstrations have been banned for the weekend. The Marseille city government also initially said it would stop public transport running on Saturday; they’ve hastily reversed that severely unpopular decision this morning. In Paris, protesters have been told they can only march a designated route between the Bastille and Nation squares.
